# WC14 · Gửi cập nhật cho người bệnh

Group **WC · Hồ sơ & Patient 360** · modal · Next.js: **restyle (U1)** (`/inbox`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/clinic.js#modalHtml`
- Patient 360 is `clinic.js › patient360()`: hero, tab bar (`data-tab`), then one body per tab. `care-finance.js` injects the linked service/prescription panels under every tab except `crm` and `history`.
- `data-modal="message"` (`modalHtml('message')`): textarea `#message-input` pre-filled with a draft for the patient and the button "Gửi tin nhắn" (`data-action=send-message`); sending adds an event to the profile and toasts "Đã gửi tin nhắn".
- Removed for the care and accountant roles (`staff-context.js › apply()`).
- Page key `patient` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor, care, accountant (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"patients\"]"} → {"click":"tr[data-patient=\"P001\"]"} → {"wait":".patient-hero"} → {"click":"[data-modal=\"message\"]"} → {"wait":".modal-backdrop .modal"}; it must show "Gửi cập nhật".

## Layout (top to bottom, from the web canvas frame, region → src/ui component)
Generated from the blocks of `Pema Web redesign canvas/Pema Web.dc.html` (frame WC14): every block is one kit component or web block (see BLOCKS.md). Names, numbers and money are the canvas sample data; labels, actions, statuses, filters and notices are the old web's, verbatim. The old web's own tree is under "Old web snapshot".
```tsx
// opens over the page "Tìm bệnh nhân" (dimmed); the page behind it is not part of this screen
<Dialog eyebrow="Tin nhắn · Nguyễn Thu Hà" title="Gửi cập nhật" width="640px">
  <Dialog.Close aria-label="Đóng hộp thoại" icon="close">"×"</Dialog.Close>
  <Field label="Nội dung" type="textarea" default="Chào bạn Hà, Pema đã xem cập nhật của bạn. Da đang được theo dõi theo kế hoạch." />
  <Dialog.Footer>
    <Button variant="primary">"Gửi tin nhắn"</Button>
  </Dialog.Footer>
</Dialog>
```
Kit components used: Dialog×1, Field×1, Button×1. Everything else (Row, Grid, Stack, Text, Heading, Progress, Avatar, Facts, Repeat, Cell…) is a plain element styled with tokens; W3 turns the recurring ones into web blocks.

## Required text (keep verbatim)
- (no notice or empty state on this screen)

## Business rules
- Clinical actions need the `clinical` capability (owner, doctor); without it `action()` answers "Cần tài khoản bác sĩ để thực hiện." and `staff-context.js › apply()` removes the controls.
- The dialog shows no emergency-channel sentence in the old web; the rule "messages are not an emergency channel" lives in the patient apps (see app groups E and G), not here.

## Differences from the app design
- Title "Gửi cập nhật" with the eyebrow "Tin nhắn · <tên>"; the Next.js target is the inbox reply box (`/inbox`).

## Gotchas
- Opening a patient from the list is a row click (`tr[data-patient]`) or the "Mở →" button; the tab is kept in the module variable `tab`, so a re-render keeps it.
